Confirmed on two first-party surfaces: the API dollar card at developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, and the Codex credit rate card at learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing, which now reads 100 / 10 / 500 credits and still resolves at $0.04 per credit to $4 / $0.40 / $20. The credit card calls it promotional: "GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026." The schema cannot carry a scheduled reversion, so that date lives only in this note. effective_from is our observation date, not a claimed change date: OpenAI publishes none, and the last-modified header on both pages (2026-08-22 05:37 UTC, within 18 seconds of each other) is a site-wide deploy stamp that post-dates our 02:12 UTC reading. GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna did not move.
